title: Build a chunked attention mask and measure its latency and context
brief: Build the chunked self-attention mask, count the context and the look-ahead delay it gives each frame, and run masked self-attention that never reads the future chunk.
hints: chunked_attention_mask: compute chunk = torch.arange(T) // chunk_size once, then compare chunk[None, :] with chunk[:, None].
context_frames is the number of True entries in each row of the mask: mask.sum(dim=1).
A frame at position p inside a chunk of C frames has C - 1 - p frames still to arrive in its chunk. Its delay is that many frames plus its own, times frame_ms.
masked_self_attention: scores = x @ x.T / sqrt(d), then scores.masked_fill(~mask, float('-inf')) before the softmax.
